title: Caterpillar Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🐛 #shorts
idea: A tobacco hornworm caterpillar increases its weight ten-thousandfold in less than 20 days.

lines.text: Ek chhota keeda 20 din mein kitna bada ho sakta hai?
Tobacco hornworm caterpillar din raat sirf patte khaata rehta hai.
20 din se bhi kam mein ye vazan 10000 guna badha leta hai!
Jaise ek insani baccha 3 hafte mein poora haathi ban jaaye!
Tabhi to is chhote keede ko eating machine kaha jaata hai!
Kya aapne kabhi itna tez badhne wala jeev dekha hai?

youtube.description:
Caterpillar ka ye sach aapke hosh uda dega! Dekhiye kaise ek chhota sa keeda 20 din mein 10,000 guna bada ho jaata hai.

#caterpillar #facts #nature #amazingfacts #shorts

facts.claim: A tobacco hornworm caterpillar increases its weight 10,000 times in less than 20 days.
